name: @exattime/awe-runtime
description: The AWE platform service layer: the reusable application services (submit run, inspect outcome, retrieve artifact and audit history, assemble and compact context, discover and invoke registered execution adapters, and the registry-backed execution control plane with approvals, pause/resume and compensation) that any future surface — app server, CLI worker, scheduled job, MCP — calls instead of re-implementing orchestration. Depends only on @exattime/awe-kernel and @exattime/awe-control-plane.
